panels.description: Select any numeric native, unknown, or derived channel. Native unknowns retain offset names and raw units.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ${x_axis:raw} AS time, ${channel:raw} AS value, 'Lap ' || lap_id AS metric FROM samples WHERE lap_id IN (${lap:csv}) AND ${channel:raw} IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lap_id,sample_index

panels.title: $channel by $x_axis

panels.description: Lap timing, fuel, cleanliness, packet format, and capture provenance.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT number,time_ms,max_speed,fuel_consumed,clean_lap,off_track_count,packet_format,native_provenance FROM laps WHERE id IN (${lap:csv}) ORDER BY number

panels.title: Lap summary

panels.description: Flattened chassis and track events with independent wheel flags.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT lap_id,type,start_dist,end_dist,severity,wheel_fl,wheel_fr,wheel_rl,wheel_rr FROM events WHERE lap_id IN (${lap:csv}) ORDER BY lap_id,event_index

panels.title: Detected events

panels.description: Compatibility channels covering speed, inputs, engine, tires, suspension, transmission, motion, racing line, flags, aids, and surface state. Use the channel selector above for every native field.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t AS time,speed,throttle,brake,rpm FROM samples WHERE lap_id=${lap:raw} ORDER BY sample_index
SELECT t AS time,slip_fl,slip_fr,slip_rl,slip_rr FROM samples WHERE lap_id=${lap:raw} ORDER BY sample_index

panels.title: Speed, inputs, engine, and wheels

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, id || ': ' || car_name || ' / ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(track_name,''),'Unknown track') AS __text FROM sessions ORDER BY id DESC

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, 'Lap ' || number || ' — ' || printf('%.3f s',time_ms/1000.0) AS __text FROM laps WHERE session_id=$session ORDER BY number

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT name AS __value, name || ' [' || unit || '; ' || confidence || ']' AS __text FROM channel_catalog WHERE storage_type IN ('real','integer') ORDER BY layer,name
